semantic.justification: Original ICU78.3 pointer-key/value UHashtable operations consumed by UnifiedCache. Native prime capacities, double hashing, tombstones, reverse rehash and slot-order iteration are retained; allocation/union ABI is projected to owned JS objects. Unconsumed APIs, native ABI/mutex/allocator and undefined-input behavior, complete UNO/display formatting, formatter/column auto-input and final CSV integration remain outside the evidence for this module. No alternate calendar selection or unsupported-known-type error is introduced.
